items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: You were talking about the Sunset All Stars. And you said that Jabbo Smith was in there... [INTERVIEWEE] Preston Jackson was on trombone... And Joe got a kick out of that. [INTERVIEWER] Well, was Jabbo Smith featured a lot with that band? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. He stayed there a while.

ctx.x:
Done Sunday, February 20th, 1977, at Mr. Randolph's home.
Interview conducted by Don DiMichael.
You were talking about the Sunset All Stars. And you said that Jabbo Smith was in there, and Zinky Zooty Singleton. Was Preston Jackson in the band?
Preston Jackson was on trombone, and Eddie Fante was on trombone.
